sloka: यजुर्वेदविनीतश्च वेदविद्भिः सुपूजितः ।धनुर्वेदे च वेदेषु वेदाङ्गेषु च निष्ठितः ।। ५.३५.१४।।।।
transliteration: yajurvedavinītaśca vedavidbhiḥ supūjitaḥ ।dhanurvede ca vedeṣu vedāṅgeṣu ca niṣṭhitaḥ ।। 5.35.14।।।।

translations.english: "He is versed in Yajurveda and is respected by Vedic scholars. He has mastered Dhanurveda and other Vedas and auxillary Vedas as well.
